newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest petrol bombs cause damage, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Budapest petrol bombs cause damage, no injuries.

text.p: Two petrol bomb attacks over the weekend in Budapest caused damage but no injuries, police said on Sunday.
One was thrown into a video shop on Friday while another was tossed into an empty bar in the centre of the capital on Saturday, Budapest Police Headquarters told the Hungarian news agency MTI.
Since September Budapest has seen almost a score of small-scale bomb attacks on property -- mainly bars and night clubs -- in what many believe is a campaign of intimidation by organised criminals.
